sn56.10:1.1: Mā bhikkhave anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakatham katheyyātha || seyyathīdaṃ ||
sn56.10:1.2: Rājakathaṃ || corakathaṃ || mahāmattakathaṃ || senākathaṃ || bhayakathaṃ || suddhakathaṃ || annakathaṃ || pānakatham || vatthakathaṃ || sayanakathaṃ || mālākathaṃ || gandha- || ñāti- || yāna- || gāmā- || nigama- || nagara- || janapada- || itthi- || purisa- || surā- || visikhā- || kumbhaṭṭhāna- || pubbapeta- || nānatta- || lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikam || itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā || ||
sn56.10:1.4: Nesā bhikkhave kathā atthasaṃhitā nādibrahmacariyikā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati || || 4.
sn56.10:2.1: Kathentā ca kho tumhe bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti katheyyātha || Ayam dukkhasamudayo ti || katheyyātha || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodho ti katheyyātha || Ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ti katheyyātha || ||
sn56.10:2.3: Esā bhikkhave kathā atthasaṃhitā esā ādibrahmacariyikā esā nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati || ||
sn56.10:3.1: Tasmāti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-[pe] || Ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || ||
